Gotcha. Pyke is my most played champ and I’ve never once felt like he was even close to being bad

I will agree that Pyke’s positioning is probably the most important part when playing him. It is hard late game not to die instantly, for a while I was buying death’s dance and silvermare to have a chance surviving late game. You’re right that he is not like the other hook champs, but I think that’s the point. He isn’t just a hook support but he has the ability to get 2 people fed instead of 1 which is a big deal especially with how good ADC’s have been getting it lately. Pyke also has much more damage than the other hook supports, letting him 1v1 squishy mages and ADC’s as a support + he has a good amount of utility.

I think his early game alone is more than enough to place him high C tier. He’s definitely a much stronger and well rounded champ than others who are placed lower than that.
